title: Greece, in Order.
note: Print palette derived for a NEW project (no prior brand file). Greece's site identity is whitewash + Aegean blue; translated for ink on warm paper. Paper is warm bone (never pure white — it greys under ink); ink is deep Aegean slate darkened one step for paper; accent is a saturated Aegean teal that survives 40% coverage; gilt is weathered brass for rules and rings. Faces differ from a website by design: display Cormorant Garamond for a Mediterranean historical register, body Spectral to hold 13.4px justified over 14k words, mono IBM Plex Mono for apparatus and the provenance marks.

fonts.display_note: Medium (500) for standfirst/lead; SemiBold (600) for H1 — never synthetic bold
